purpose: Reconcile the printed moving-average ODE with the exact moving-control-volume storage identity before any moving-water-table response comparison or SWAP groundwater bridge.

authority.primary_paper: He et al. 2021 J Hydrol 602 126797 DOI 10.1016/j.jhydrol.2021.126797
authority.assessment_paper: He et al. 2022 J Hydrol 613A 128327 DOI 10.1016/j.jhydrol.2022.128327

public_author_dataset.role: preferred later trajectory reproduction oracle when exact bytes are available

CONSERVATIVE_PRODUCT.role: exact moving-control-volume identity implied by the average definition plus continuity

PRINTED_AVERAGE_LITERAL.role: literal reading of the displayed moving-average ODE in the 2021/2022 papers; not assumed equivalent to product form

test_path.state_path: hydrostatic equilibrium profile referenced to the prescribed water-table depth H(t), used only as a physically admissible manufactured moving-state path
test_path.theta: Mualem-Van Genuchten retention using the frozen source material parameters
test_path.quadrature: high-accuracy deterministic numerical quadrature of theta over each active virtual layer
test_path.rationale: Provides physically valid theta_bar(H) over both H<=h and H>h without using future response or fitting.

diagnostics: analytic and numerical H=h transition time
moving layer thickness and storage continuity at H=h
literal printed-form ledger defect evaluated on the same state path
theoretical residual identity R_LITERAL-R_PRODUCT = -theta_bar*dHdt and its magnitude theta_bar*abs(dHdt)
maximum and time-integrated absolute defect by material and regime

adjudication.equivalent_only_if: literal and product control-volume residuals are both within numerical identity gate over all tested positive-thickness states
adjudication.non_equivalent_if: product residual is within gate and literal residual exceeds gate consistently with theta_bar*dHdt
adjudication.interpretation_firewall: NON_EQUIVALENT does not by itself label the published implementation wrong; it triggers source/output reproduction before choosing BC2 dynamics.

pre_execution_residual_sign_clarificatio.scientific_effect: Sign convention clarification only; candidate forms, path and gates unchanged.
